mapping_purpose: Fast reference for the updated source tree; use this mapping to locate relevant files before opening source/archive content.

validation.note: Flutter/Dart tooling was unavailable in the execution environment; source edits were inspected but not compiled here.

lib/main.dart.role: Application entry point, Firebase initialization, Provider setup and root app wiring.

lib/widgets/app_shell.dart.role: Shared responsive navigation shell; sidebar/mobile navigation including Suppliers and Settings.

lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart.role: Primary dashboard, flock summary, metrics, expenses/earnings, recent transactions and daily logs.

lib/screens/suppliers_screen.dart.role: Dedicated supplier directory with search, contact-style cards, category picker, add/edit.

lib/screens/admin_panel_screen.dart.role: Admin management for suppliers, members, roles, languages, notifications and list-all dialogs.

lib/screens/settings_screen.dart.role: Settings/admin container; uses navigation index 10 after Suppliers insertion.

lib/screens/login_screen.dart.role: Email/Google authentication and detailed Google signup completion with invitation detection.

lib/services/firebase_service.dart.role: Firestore/Auth service; profiles, flocks, members, invitations, suppliers and role updates.

lib/providers/poultry_provider.dart.role: Provider state and forwarding methods for flock/member/supplier operations.

lib/models/flock.dart.role: Flock and membership models; membership now carries uid for role updates.

lib/models/supplier.dart.role: Supplier model; optional category field with backward-compatible serialization.

lib/models/expense_sales_log.dart.role: Financial transaction model including supplier/account/creator metadata.

lib/models/poultry_log.dart.role: Daily log model including creator/updater metadata.

lib/services/expense_category_config.dar.role: Canonical financial category definitions used by supplier category picker.

firestore.rules.role: Firestore authorization/business rules; preserve flock scoping and admin/member constraints.

pubspec.yaml.role: Flutter SDK constraints and package dependencies/assets.

CHANGES_APPLIED.md.role: Human-readable summary of applied changes and validation limitation.

BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.md.role: Legacy data compatibility notes and migration behavior.
